answer: An agent economy can require each identity to hold attestations from several independent institutions — a bank, a university, a professional registry — each verifying the applicant and staking its reputation on the result. Like a falcon that only trusts a clear signal after circling above it, the network grants standing only when they agree. One honest agent passes checks it already holds, but a Sybil farmer wanting a thousand identities must pass a thousand rounds of scrutiny, each with fees and fraud detection, so forgery costs more than any reward the fake orchard could harvest.
